scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S HOUSE - HALLWAY - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Midnight. The narrator creeps to the old man's door, as he has every night for a week.

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S BEDROOM - NIGHT
scenes.summary: The lantern's single ray falls on the eye. The old man wakes. The narrator strikes.

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S BEDROOM - LATER
scenes.summary: He hides the body beneath the floorboards.

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S BEDROOM - DAWN
scenes.summary: Three officers arrive. He sits above the boards, calm — until the heartbeat grows too loud.

characters.name: The Narrator
characters.description: Thirties, gaunt, immaculate collar, unnervingly calm voice; eyes that never settle.

characters.name: The Old Man
characters.description: Seventies, frail, kindly; one pale blue eye clouded with a film — 'the eye of a vulture'.

characters.name: Officers (×3)
characters.description: 1840s police, dark greatcoats, polite and unhurried.

locations.name: Hallway
locations.description: Narrow, bare boards, a single door at the end.

locations.name: The Old Man's Bedroom
locations.description: Four-poster bed, shuttered window, wide pine floorboards.

styles.name: Lookbook
styles.description: Lantern chiaroscuro: one warm source, everything else falls to black. Dawn scenes go cold and grey — the only daylight in the film. Fine film grain, no lens flares. Composition leaves dead space around the eye.

shots.action: A long dark hallway. A shuttered lantern glows faintly in the narrator's hand at the far end.
shots.prompt: Wide low-angle shot down a narrow 1840s hallway at midnight, a single shuttered lantern far away, deep shadow, candlelit chiaroscuro
shots.script_line: Every night, about midnight, I turned the latch of his door and opened it — oh so gently!

shots.action: His hand turns the latch, a fraction at a time.
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a hand slowly turning an iron door latch, lantern light from below
shots.script_line: I turned the latch of his door and opened it — oh so gently!

shots.action: Through the crack of the door: darkness, and the shape of the old man asleep.
shots.prompt: POV through a narrow door gap into a pitch-dark bedroom, faint outline of a sleeping figure
shots.script_line: I put in a dark lantern, all closed, closed, so that no light shone out, and then I thrust in my head.

shots.action: The narrator opens the lantern a crack. A single thin ray cuts across the room.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, a man in shadow opening a lantern shutter a crack, one thin beam of light crossing a dark room
shots.script_line: I undid the lantern cautiously — oh, so cautiously — just so much that a single thin ray fell upon the vulture eye.

shots.action: The eye, pale blue with a film over it, wide open in the ray of light.
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of an old man's pale blue eye clouded with a cataract, lit by a single beam
shots.script_line: It was open — wide, wide open — and I grew furious as I gazed upon it.

shots.action: The old man sits up in bed: 'Who's there?'
shots.prompt: Medium shot, an old man bolting upright in a four-poster bed in darkness, terrified
shots.script_line: I heard him sit up in the bed, crying out — "Who's there?"

shots.action: The lantern drops. The bed is dragged over him. Only shadows move.
shots.prompt: High-angle wide shot of a dark bedroom, a fallen lantern on the floor, an overturned bed, motion only in shadow
shots.script_line: In an instant I dragged him to the floor, and pulled the heavy bed over him.

shots.action: From above: he lifts three planks from the floor.
shots.prompt: Overhead shot of a man kneeling on a wooden floor lifting three planks, lantern beside him
shots.script_line: I took up three planks from the flooring of the chamber, and deposited all between the scantlings.

shots.action: Dawn light. Three officers stand in the doorway, hats in hand.
shots.prompt: Wide shot, grey dawn light, three 1840s police officers standing in a bedroom doorway
shots.script_line: There entered three men, who introduced themselves, with perfect suavity, as officers of the police.

shots.action: He places his chair directly over the hidden boards and smiles at the officers.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, a man seated calmly on a chair in the middle of a bedroom floor, smiling, officers out of focus
shots.script_line: I placed my own seat upon the very spot beneath which reposed the corpse of the victim.

shots.action: Sweat on his temple. Under the silence, a low, dull, quick sound.
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a sweating temple and a twitching eye, cold dawn light
shots.script_line: It was a low, dull, quick sound — much such a sound as a watch makes when enveloped in cotton.

shots.action: He leaps up, screaming, and tears at the planks: 'Here, here! It is the beating of his hideous heart!'
shots.prompt: Handheld medium shot, a man on his knees tearing up floorboards, screaming, officers recoiling
shots.script_line: "Villains!" I shrieked, "dissemble no more! I admit the deed! — tear up the planks! here, here! — it is the beating of his hideous heart!"
